title: New-Level Reserve on Everyday Pay Card Cashouts — Cartwise Shopper Payouts Standing Rules
content:
Cartwise Shopper Payouts keeps a new-level reserve on the account while a level change is recent, whenever an instant cashout onto the Everyday Pay Card is worked out: where the shopper's latest level evaluation (or, when the contractor account carries none, the payout account's opening) was fewer than 60 days ago and the shopper is at Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond level, 25.00 stays; where it was fewer than 60 days ago and the shopper is below Full-Service Shopper Platinum level, 10.00 stays; otherwise nothing stays.

## Records read

- **Latest level evaluation** — the date of the shopper's latest level evaluation on the Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Where that record carries no level evaluation, the opening date of the shopper's payout account is used in its place.
- **Days ago** — the days from that date to the day of the cashout; the reserve applies only when this is fewer than 60.
- **Shopper level** — the current level on the Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record. Levels rank upward in the order Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver, Full-Service Shopper Gold, Full-Service Shopper Platinum and Full-Service Shopper Diamond, and a level named with "or above" or "or below" is read in that order; "below Full-Service Shopper Platinum" therefore covers Shop-Only Shopper, Full-Service Shopper, Full-Service Shopper Silver and Full-Service Shopper Gold.

## Condition table

| Days since the latest level evaluation (or payout account opening) | Shopper level | New-level reserve |
|---|---|---|
| fewer than 60 | Full-Service Shopper Platinum or Diamond | 25.00 |
| fewer than 60 | below Full-Service Shopper Platinum | 10.00 |
| 60 or more | any level | nothing |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)

- Level evaluated 59 days before the cashout, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Diamond: fewer than 60, so 25.00 stays.
- Level evaluated exactly 60 days before the cashout, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Diamond: not fewer than 60, so nothing stays.
- Level evaluated 12 days before the cashout, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Gold: 10.00 stays.
- No level evaluation on the contractor account and a payout account opened 30 days before the cashout, shopper at Full-Service Shopper Silver: the opening date is used, 30 is fewer than 60, so 10.00 stays.
